subject: Private Offer activation map & sprint plan — Acme Retail
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Private Offer activation map & sprint plan — Acme Retail

Hi Jill —

As discussed on the call this morning, attached is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to accelerate the AWS Marketplace Private Offer activation and the procurement/billing path so you can onboard before your Q1 promo window. Key objectives in the sheet:

- Week 1 (this week): legal/PO template confirmation + vendor checklist
- Week 2: contract execution (DocuSign), AWS private-offer creation by Redwood and approval by Acme
- Week 3: test billing and integrate consolidated billing settings
- Week 4: production go-live + monitoring handoff

Please review the milestones in the attached Redwood_MAP_Acme_20281109.xlsx. I flagged the decision owners in column C — would like to confirm owners for: procurement PO, legal signoff, and the platform integration test lead.

Two narrow asks to keep momentum:
1) Can your procurement team confirm the required PO naming and account number by EOD Wednesday (11/11)?
2) Can legal confirm whether Acme will accept Redwood’s standard AWS Marketplace Addendum or require redlines?

I copied Laura and Karthik to cover billing/integration questions — Karthik will outline the exact AWS private-offer steps and the invoice flow in his follow-up.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Acme_20281109.xlsx, PO_TEMPLATE_AWS_PRIVATE.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0187
From: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@acmeretail.com>, legal@acmeretail.com
Date: 2028-11-09T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer activation map & sprint plan — Acme Retail

Kimberly — thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. A few items from procurement/legal that will affect timing:

- PO format: we need the vendor name and Redwood’s AWS Marketplace vendor ID on the PO. Can you confirm the vendor ID and the exact billing name we should use?
- Contract: legal attached a vendor questionnaire and asked if you can complete the security appendix (SOC2 scope and data residency statement).
- Payment terms: Acme standard is Net 45 but we may be able to do Net 30 for new vendors on marketplace commitments; need finance approval.

We’ll try to confirm the PO metadata by 11/11 but legal will likely need until 11/14 to review the addendum and questionnaire. Attaching our questionnaire: ACME_vendor_questionnaire.docx

If you can populate the vendor ID and a suggested invoice schedule (monthly vs. quarterly), that helps speed approval.

Best,
Jill Park
Head of Procurement, Acme Retail
jill.park@acmeretail.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeretail.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-10T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer activation map & sprint plan — Acme Retail

Thanks Jill — quick answers and a suggested billing path so procurement can draft the PO: 

1) Redwood AWS Marketplace vendor ID: 0123456789 (please include this on the PO).
2) Billing name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (tax ID XX-XXXXXXX)
3) Recommended invoice schedule: monthly invoicing, net 30 — we can accept Net 45 if required but monthly gives better forecasting for your team.
4) Marketplace/PO flow (high level): 
   - Redwood generates AWS Private Offer and sends offer ID to Acme for acceptance in AWS Console (2–3 business days post-contract).
   - Acme issues PO referenced to the Private Offer ID and Redwood’s vendor ID.
   - AWS Marketplace processes billing and charges to Acme’s consolidated billing account; Redwood receives aggregated payments from AWS per the Marketplace settlement schedule.

Attached is a short checklist explaining the private-offer steps and the fields your procurement team should include: aws-private-offer-steps.md

Security appendix: we are happy to complete the questionnaire. I’ll coordinate with our security lead and return the SOC2 scope and data residency statement by 11/13.

If procurement confirms vendor ID and PO format by 11/11, we should be on track for the Week 2 contract execution in your MAP.

— Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Private Offer activation map & sprint plan — Acme Retail

Jill/Kimberly — quick update from our side following internal approvals: 

- Legal: will accept Redwood’s standard AWS Marketplace Addendum with one small clarification on data-retention (we added a short sentence; we’ll share the redline within 24 hours).
- Finance: can approve Net 45 on first year, with a review at 90 days for Net 30 consideration.
- Integration lead confirmed: Maya Srinivasan will own the platform test plan and will be available for the integration window starting 11/27.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll upload the finalized MAP (incorporating Karthik’s vendor ID and invoice schedule) to the shared Drive and send a DocuSign envelope for the Addendum by EOD today: https://docusign.com/exec/abcd-1234-sign
2) Acme to provide PO with vendor ID and billing name after legal confirms addendum (target 11/16)
3) Kickoff: schedule 30-min technical kickoff with Maya and Karthik for 11/27 — Kimberly, can you coordinate calendar invites once we have PO in place?

Attachments: we’ve placed the PO_TEMPLATE_AWS_PRIVATE.pdf in the folder and will post the redline shortly.

Thanks — Laura
